tools.name: make_website
tools.description: Build a real website for the user's business, club, building, class or project from a sentence or two, with its own AI that answers visitors' questions. Hostlet designs the whole thing (words, layout, photos, logo) in about two minutes. It returns right away with a live card and the address; the sit

tools.name: make_ai
tools.description: Make a simple chat AI (like a small ChatGPT for one job, with a chat history) on its own page, in a few seconds. Use when the user wants just an assistant, not a website.

tools.name: change_site
tools.description: Change a site made with make_website, in plain words: "make the headline shorter", "add our hours: Tue to Sun 7 to 3", "add a section about catering", "use warmer colors". Pass exactly what the user asked for.

tools.name: check_site
tools.description: Show a Hostlet site or AI the user made, as a card, and whether it is finished building.

tools.name: add_document
tools.description: Give a site's AI a document to answer visitors from (a menu, price list, rules, FAQ): pass its title and full text.

tools.name: ask_site
tools.description: Ask any public Hostlet site's AI a question (e.g. "night-owls" for night-owls.hostlet.ai). Pass passcode if the site has one, or owner_key for your own.
